race.description: Join The Derby Club 2026 Country Boosted Mdn Plate
race.comment: MAZORT (10) wound up strongly last time out to finish a close second over 800m at Narromine when coming back from a break. Blinkers come off second up. Fitter so a bold showing is likely. FABULOUS ONE (4) has not raced for over a year when she finished fifth at Ballarat Synthetic. Has trialled well in readiness for the new stable and can play a role fresh. KNIGHTS TEMPLAR (2) is facing the starter for the first time. By Knight Exemplar and hails from the Myron Cooper stable. Fitter for a pair of trials in readiness and looks forward enough. Top-three chance. COOLY ROCKS (3) returns after 687 days and has her first start for the Hazelton stable. Her QLD form reads strongly for this but suspect she will need a hitout or two. Keeping safe.
